operators.name: bilinear_upsample
semantics: Performs bilinear upsampling using scale_factor (float) on 4D input tensor.
align_corners is False (PyTorch default for nn.Upsample).
Output spatial dims: H_out = floor(H_in * scale_factor), W_out = floor(W_in * scale_factor).
Pixel mapping: src_x = (dst_x + 0.5) / scale_factor - 0.5, clamped to [-0.5, H_in-1+0.5] for interpolation, then clamp to [0, H_in-1] for indices.
Bilinear weights computed from fractional positions.

operators.name: logical_and_threshold
semantics: Computes elementwise logical AND of (x > 0) and (x < 1).
Output dtype torch.bool, same shape as input.
Input float32 [16,3,512,1024], output float32 [16,3,1024,2048] on cuda
Elementwise comparison x > 0 and x < 1, combined with logical AND
Input float32, output bool same shape
Returns the boolean tensor from step_002
